minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the 494 Electric Ave, 711 Mass Ave and 23 Electric Ave items to March 24 and approved a master plan appointee.
minutes.summary: The board took up a volunteer for the master plan steering committee, endorsed an ANR for 255 Sunny Hill Road 3-1, and handled a de minimis canopy change for 494 Electric Avenue. Hearings for 494 Electric Ave, 994 Northfield Road and 23 Electric Ave were continued to March 24. Much of the evening went to the unresolved road-ownership question at 494 Electric, standard conditions for decisions, and zoning articles for town meeting.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the 494 Electric Avenue hearing, with the Pierce Avenue ownership question still open, to March 24.
The board continued the 994 Northfield Road site plan hearing and the 23 Electric Avenue stormwater hearing to March 24 after neighbor testimony on the parking lot.
The board endorsed the ANR for 255 Sunny Hill Road, 3-1.
The board required peer review funds from the 711 Mass Ave applicant for stormwater design review and deferred its decision until the review engineer responds.
Two decisions were signed; the Goodrich and Sunny Hill stormwater decisions wait on standard conditions, which will go to a vote at the next meeting.

why_it_matters: Nothing was finally decided on 494 Electric Avenue, 994 Northfield Road or 23 Electric Avenue, so neighbors and applicants wait for March 24, and the road-ownership question at 494 Electric is still unsettled.
A vote on standard conditions for all permit decisions is coming; those conditions will shape what later stormwater and site plan approvals require.
Zoning language on accessory dwelling units and flood plains is moving toward town meeting, where residents will be asked to vote on it.
watch_next: March 24 at 6:05 p.m.: continued hearings for 494 Electric Ave, 994 Northfield Road and 23 Electric Ave, plus the 711 Mass Ave de minimis change.
The next agenda: a motion and vote on updated standard conditions, and the draft decision for 494 Electric Ave with special conditions.
